violation_type.title: Emergency Exit Not Through Kitchen or Hazardous Area (26 TAC §744.3563(d))
violation_type.short_title: Emergency Exit Not Through Kitchen or Hazardous Area
violation_type.typical_finding: One of the required exits for the operations is through the kitchen area or hazardous construction area. All other doors are locked.
